notes.title: Pebble Knights Demo Patch Notes - Update 0.34.6
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229700/b3642c1542f78bbc750a269983cce3198e4fb05b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Pebble Knights![/p][p]Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've made improvements to ensure a more stable and enjoyable experience in Pebble Knights.[/p][p]Check out the details below![/p][p][/p][h1]New Features & Improvements[/h1][p][/p][h2]Merchant System Overhaul[/h2][list][*][p]The merchant has become more dynamic.[/p][list][*][p]New entrance and exit animations have been added. The merchant now roams the map and sells items directly.[/p][/*][*][p]When the merchant appears, their location is marked on the bottom-right UI of the screen.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Weapon Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]"Hold to attack" is now maintained even after reloading ranged weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Some weapons now have bonus critical hit chance:[/p][list][*][p]High Heels, Stone Sword: +3%[/p][/*][*][p]Spear, Throwing Star, Reaper’s Scythe: +5%[/p][/*][*][p]Shuriken (Kunai), Karambit: +10%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Convenience & Accessibility[/b][/h2][list][*][p]For streamers, all background music has been replaced with original tracks free from copyright issues.[/p][/*][*][p]A feature has been added to prevent photosensitive seizures:[/p][list][*][p] A flashing light warning is shown when the game starts, and a new '[b]Flash Protection Mode'[/b] is available in settings.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Optimization[/b][/h2][list][*][p] General performance has been improved to reduce in-game lag.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the merchant would occasionally not bring any items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where critical hit chance was unintentionally reduced in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed rare cases where the host connection would drop or the game would crash.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re doing our best to make Pebble Knights even more fun.[/p][p]Thank you for all your support and feedback![/p][p]– Pebble Knights Team[/p][p][/p][h2]For more news and updates, join us on Discord! [/h2][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/hEuztrkbhy  "]https://discord.com/invite/hEuztrkbhy  [/url][/p]

notes.title: Pebble Knights Demo Hotfix (250626)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229700/b3642c1542f78bbc750a269983cce3198e4fb05b.png"][/img]Hello, Pebble Knights!

 Thanks to your valuable feedback and gameplay data, we've rolled out a hotfix to address urgent balance adjustments and bug fixes.

 Your [b]active reports[/b] played a big part in resolving many of these issues. Thank you again for your support![/p][p][/p][h1][b]Game Balance[/b][/h1][h2]
[b]Trait Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Sleep Paralysis: [/b]Now evolves faster.[/p][list][*][p]Time to meet the evolution condition "Don't attack" has been reduced (70s → 50s)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hug Me: [/b]You can now heal allies more effectively.[/p][list][*][p] Healing range increased (0.8 → 1.2)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Medic Kick: [/b]Now more viable for strategic use thanks to increased healing.[/p][list][*][p]Healing amount increased (10 → 20)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Monster Changes[/b][/h2][p]Rafflesia returns as a more overwhelming threat.[/p][list][*][p]Its vines now have longer reach and attack range. If you fail to escape in time, you’ll be inflicted with Poison.[/p][/*][*][p]While caught in the vines, other monsters can still track and attack the player.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of Rafflesia units has been reduced.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Team Upgrade Changes[/b][/h2][p]Vending Machine: Now provides more items, and more quickly.[/p][list][*][p]Hits required to activate reduced (8~15 → 5~10)[/p][/*][*][p]Jackpot chance for extra item drops increased (5% → 10%)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the text shown while struggling in a grabbed state displayed in the wrong language regardless of settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Join or Create Room buttons would occasionally become unresponsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where non-king players would sometimes not see the selection badge on the right side.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the "Body Slam" trait could trigger on already dead enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some Angel and Devil room badges not functioning correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the King could lift dead, invisible allies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a pathing issue where players (including AIs) could block each other’s movement.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to your continued feedback, we were able to fix many bugs. 
Please keep the reports coming![/p][p][/p][p]We’ll keep doing our best to make Pebble Knights even more fun.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]– The Pebble Knights Team[/p][p][/p][h2]Join the community on Discord[/h2][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/hEuztrkbhy"]https://discord.com/invite/hEuztrkbhy[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229700/b3642c1542f78bbc750a269983cce3198e4fb05b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Pebble Knights![/p][p]We’ve added new features and improvements for a more enjoyable play experience.
Check out the details below![/p][p][/p][h1]New Features & Improvements[/h1][p][/p][h2]Traditional Chinese Added[/h2][p]Pebble Knights is gaining fame worldwide! Thank you so much for your warm support.[/p][list][*][p]By popular demand, you can now enjoy Pebble Knights in Traditional Chinese.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]AI (Bot) Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]We’ve adjusted some AI (Bot) behavior patterns so they don’t interfere with player gameplay.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other Changes[/h2][list][*][p]A “Copy Room Code” feature has been added to help you share private room codes with friends faster.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Game Balance [/h2][h3]Weapons [/h3][list][*][p]Revolver: Increased magazine capacity (6 → 12) [/p][/*][*][p]Military Boots: Damage increased (52 → 54)  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Monsters [/h3][list][*][p]Giant Plant: HP increased (700 → 900)  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Others [/h3][list][*][p]Treasure Room: Time limit extended (40 seconds → 50 seconds)  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes [/h1][list][*][p]Fixed intermittent disconnection issues with hosts. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain texts appearing in the wrong language under some language settings. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where some icons stayed the same even after changing control keys. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing weapon attack sounds. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weird eating animation when consuming some weapons. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where certain treasure chest items appeared suspiciously often under specific conditions. [/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll keep doing our best to make Pebble Knights even more fun.
Please continue to send us your feedback and support! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, [/p][p]- Pebble Knights Team  [/p][p][/p][h2]For more news and updates, join us on Discord! [/h2][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/hEuztrkbhy  "]https://discord.com/invite/hEuztrkbhy  [/url][/p]

notes.title: Pebble Knights Demo Patch Notes - Update 0.34.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229700/b3642c1542f78bbc750a269983cce3198e4fb05b.png[/img]

Hello, Pebble Knights!
We've added new features and made improvements for a better gameplay experience.
Check out the full details below!

[h1]New Features & Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Tutorial Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Learn the rules and controls with the new tutorial. Great for first-time players.
[/list]

[h2]AI(Bot) Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] AI behavior has been refined to avoid interfering with player actions.
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Selected badges and traits are now clearly displayed on the Team Upgrade and Trait Evolution screens.
[*] The merchant NPC now has a stronger presence.
[*] The King can now swing a Pebble Knight and steal their weapon.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where ready item remained after leaving the lobby.
[*] Fixed a bug where the cursor overlapped some UI text.
[*] Fixed occasional disconnection issues with the host.
[*] Fixed inaccurate DPS readings in the lobby’s sandbag.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where nothing appeared during the King's trait evolution.
[/list]

We're working hard to make Pebble Knights even more fun.
Thank you for your support and feedback!
– Pebble Knights Team
